questions.question: Are the requested elements animated without extending the preset to protected elements or the whole page?
questions.why: The wrong parts of the design animate.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The wrong parts of the design animate.

questions.say_example: The animation also applies to <the background>, which should stay still.

questions.question: Does the element perform its retained animation preset when the scene plays?
questions.why: The intended preset animation is missing or replaced.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The intended preset animation is missing or replaced.

questions.question: Does the motion-path preset give the element the requested trajectory?

questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The preset moves the element through the wrong area.

questions.question: Are the original and added effects both still attached to the intended element?

questions.whatTheAgentLoses: Part of the combined animation disappears.

questions.question: Does the character perform the requested action and its required expression?

questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The character communicates the wrong action or emotion.

questions.question: Does the page-wide animation produce the style required across the design?
questions.why: The overall page motion differs from the request.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The overall page motion differs from the request.
questions.check: Does every element on the page show the page-wide animation effect applied, or does one element stay out of it?
questions.say_example: <The sidebar icon> does not join the required page animation.

questions.question: Does the preset move or reveal the element in the requested direction?
questions.why: The animation follows the wrong visual direction.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The animation follows the wrong visual direction.
questions.check: From which side of the canvas does the element's entrance preset originate?
questions.say_example: Set the entrance preset to come from <the left>

questions.question: Does the preset entrance last for the requested duration?

questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The entrance runs too quickly or too slowly for its assigned timing.

questions.question: Does the preset entrance begin at its requested cue?

questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The element enters at the wrong moment.

questions.question: Does the text remain visible until the cut when the request requires it?

questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The text is removed before its required display interval ends.

questions.question: Has the unwanted preset stopped affecting the intended element or page?

questions.question: Do the element's presets overlap or follow one another as requested?

questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The combined movement does not read as the requested action.
questions.check: Do the two combined animation presets' timelines overlap, or does one end before the other begins?
questions.say_example: Set <the fade-out> and <the fade-in> to overlap for <0.5 seconds>

questions.question: Does the preset leave the element at the requested size?

questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The element ends too large or too small.
questions.check: What final scale value does the preset leave the element at?
questions.say_example: Set the final scale to <100%>

questions.question: Does the graphic travel within the requested distance limits?
questions.why: The graphic moves too far or too little.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The graphic moves too far or too little.
questions.check: What distance or intensity value is set for the Drift effect?
questions.say_example: Set the Drift intensity to <20%>

questions.question: Does each preset-driven text reveal finish before that text disappears?
questions.why: Some text is never shown.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: Some text is never shown.

children.label: Animate the text
children.note: Choose 5.5.1 and set its amount through 5.5.10, then use 5.5.2 through 5.5.5 to control which characters move and when. Use 5.5.6 for randomized order, 5.5.7 when several animators must work together, 5.5.8 for a varying selector, and 5.5.9 for independent character depth.

questions.question: Does the selector reveal all required text within its assigned interval?

questions.question: Do the characters visibly travel from the requested depth into their resting positions?

questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The requested depth effect is absent or reversed.

questions.question: Is the revealed text as sharp and visible as required once it settles?

questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The revealed content remains hard to see.
questions.check: Does the text layer's blur effect return to its base value by the end of the reveal?

questions.question: Do the characters grow from zero height without an unwanted width change?

questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The text reveal uses the wrong deformation.
questions.check: Does the scale range selector affect only the height property, or does it also change the width property?

questions.question: Does each reveal step add exactly the intended next word?
questions.why: The reveal breaks the requested reading sequence.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The reveal breaks the requested reading sequence.
questions.check: Does each range-selector step's end percentage align with the boundary of the next intended word in the text?
questions.say_example: The step at <0:08> reveals <'Save Big'>, instead of <'Save 30%'>.

questions.question: Does the text reveal by the requested characters, words, or lines?

questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The reveal has the wrong reading rhythm.

questions.question: Does the color sweep reach the requested characters at the specified times?
questions.why: The wrong text is colored or the emphasis occurs at the wrong time.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The wrong text is colored or the emphasis occurs at the wrong time.

questions.question: Does the text selector produce the requested pattern of movement through the text?
questions.why: The text moves with the wrong rhythm or distribution.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The text moves with the wrong rhythm or distribution.
questions.check: What shape option is selected for the text range selector?
questions.say_example: Set the range selector shape to <a ramp>

questions.question: Does the text appear in the requested order?
questions.why: The reveal changes the intended sequence or effect.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The reveal changes the intended sequence or effect.
questions.check: Does the range selector's Randomize Order setting match what the reveal was requested to use?
questions.say_example: <The headline> reveals in reading order, but the request calls for a random order.

questions.question: Do the combined text animators leave the revealed text on its intended baseline?
questions.why: The text settles in the wrong place.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The text settles in the wrong place.
questions.check: What vertical position value do the combined animators leave the text at once both finish?
questions.say_example: Set the combined animators to end at <the frame's center>

questions.question: Does the text overshoot and settle by the amount and timing the request calls for?
questions.why: The text has the wrong bounce or remains distorted.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The text has the wrong bounce or remains distorted.
questions.check: Does the duplicated animator's value return to its base value after the overshoot keyframe, or does it stay offset?

questions.question: Does character spacing continue to expand during the requested interval after the reveal?
questions.why: The requested secondary text motion is missing or mistimed.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The requested secondary text motion is missing or mistimed.
questions.check: Does the character-spacing animator continue changing for its full assigned interval after the reveal finishes, or does it stop early?
questions.say_example: The spacing stops changing when <the headline> appears, before the requested expansion.

questions.question: Can the requested color transition actually be seen while the text is visible?
questions.why: The authored color animation has no visible effect.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The authored color animation has no visible effect.
questions.check: Does the color-change animator's active time range overlap with the interval when the text's opacity is already above zero?
questions.say_example: The color change finishes before <the caption> becomes visible.

questions.question: Does the Wiggly selector produce visible motion on the intended text?
questions.why: The automatic text motion is absent.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The automatic text motion is absent.
questions.check: Does the text layer's position or rotation value actually change over time once the Wiggly selector is applied?
questions.say_example: <The subtitle> stays still throughout the intended wiggle passage.

questions.question: Does the text wiggle change at the requested pace?
questions.why: The procedural motion has the wrong rhythm.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The procedural motion has the wrong rhythm.
questions.check: What temporal frequency value is set on the Wiggly selector?
questions.say_example: Set the Wiggly selector frequency to <3Hz>

questions.question: Does the text layer provide the independent character depth required for editing this effect?
questions.why: The requested character depth cannot be edited independently.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The requested character depth cannot be edited independently.
questions.check: Does the text layer's Animate menu show a per-character 3D or depth option, or only a whole-layer option?
questions.say_example: <The headline layer> only exposes whole-layer depth; independent character depth is not available.

questions.question: Does the text travel from the requested starting side and distance into its resting position?
questions.why: The text enters along the wrong visual route.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The text enters along the wrong visual route.
questions.check: From which side and at what distance does the text layer's entrance keyframe start?
questions.say_example: Set the text entrance to start from <the right> at <200px>

questions.question: Do the letters or symbols stay within the requested movement and rotation range?
questions.why: The text moves too far, too little, or outside its allowed area.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The text moves too far, too little, or outside its allowed area.
questions.check: What position and rotation range values are set on the wiggle expression?
questions.say_example: Set the wiggle range to <10px>

children.label: Animate the effects
children.note: Choose 5.6.1, place 5.6.2 when the effect has spatial controls, then set 5.6.3 and coordinate 5.6.4. Use 5.6.5 if procedural movement is appropriate.

questions.question: Is the motion effect attached at the intended layer or nested-instance scope?
questions.why: The wrong content receives the effect.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The wrong content receives the effect.
questions.check: Which layer or nested-instance does the effect's applied-to setting show it's attached to?
questions.say_example: <The Wiggle effect> is attached to <the whole layer>, instead of <a single letter>.

questions.question: Does the applied effect produce the requested movement on the character or body part?
questions.why: The effect fails to create the required character movement.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The effect fails to create the required character movement.
questions.check: Does the grouped character's body part show position or rotation keyframes changing over time after the effect is applied?
questions.say_example: <The tail> stays still during its requested <wag>.

questions.question: Does the wind effect move the intended object as the request or reference requires?
questions.why: The environmental motion reads incorrectly.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The environmental motion reads incorrectly.
questions.check: Does the wind effect's applied-to setting show it's attached to the specific object, or to the whole scene?
questions.say_example: The whole scene shakes where only <the flag> should respond to the wind.

questions.question: Does the fire show the requested turbulent movement?
questions.why: The fire motion or its scope is wrong.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The fire motion or its scope is wrong.
questions.check: Does the turbulence effect's applied region stay within the fire layer's boundary, or does it extend beyond it?
questions.say_example: The turbulence also distorts <the character's face>.

questions.question: Does the reflection visibly flicker during the requested passage?
questions.why: The requested reflected-light effect is missing or misplaced.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The requested reflected-light effect is missing or misplaced.
questions.check: Does the reflection layer's opacity or brightness value change over time during the intended flicker passage?
questions.say_example: The reflection stays constant during the requested flicker passage.

questions.question: Does the character shake with the intensity and pattern required by the request?
questions.why: The character's reaction has the wrong movement.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The character's reaction has the wrong movement.
questions.check: What frequency and displacement amount values are set on the shaking effect?
questions.say_example: Set the shaking effect to <5px> at <8Hz>

questions.question: Does the starting Bend keyframe produce the requested initial distortion?
questions.why: The deformation begins in the wrong state.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The deformation begins in the wrong state.
questions.check: What area does the Bend effect's starting keyframe show it's centered on?
questions.say_example: <The flag> bends around the wrong area in its starting state.

questions.question: Does the bend reach and retain its requested ending shape?
questions.why: The distortion ends or holds incorrectly.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The distortion ends or holds incorrectly.
questions.check: Does the Bend effect's value stay constant across the keyframes marking its required ending hold?
questions.say_example: The bend changes again during the required ending hold.

questions.question: Does the effect layer cover exactly the interval required for its target?
questions.why: The effect is missing for part of its passage or spills into another scene.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The effect is missing for part of its passage or spills into another scene.
questions.check: Does the effect layer's in/out points match exactly the interval its target requires, without falling short or extending into the next scene?
questions.say_example: <The glow effect> extends past its target into <the following scene>.

questions.question: Does the motion expression evaluate without errors on the intended property?
questions.why: The procedural animation cannot run as authored.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The procedural animation cannot run as authored.
questions.check: Does the expression editor show an error message on this property's expression?
questions.say_example: The expression on <the rotation property> reports <a divide-by-zero error> at <0:23>.

questions.question: Does the expression produce the requested ongoing text flicker?
questions.why: The procedural effect does not produce its requested visible behavior.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The procedural effect does not produce its requested visible behavior.
questions.check: Does the flicker expression's active range cover the whole passage it's assigned to?
questions.say_example: The flicker stops at <0:39>, before the requested passage ends.

children.label: Reuse the animation
children.note: Use 5.7.1 and 5.7.2 to save selected motion. Use 5.7.4 and 5.7.5 to apply saved motion to another target without unintentionally replacing its content. Use 5.7.6 to transfer an easing curve between existing keyframes.

questions.question: Did the intended source effect reach the target with its required settings and protected artwork intact?
questions.why: Effect reuse changes the wrong content or fails to reproduce the intended setup.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: Effect reuse changes the wrong content or fails to reproduce the intended setup.
questions.check: Does the target element's Effects list show the same effect and settings as the copied source, with the source's own content untouched?
questions.say_example: <The second layer> received <a Gaussian blur>, rather than the copied <Drop Shadow>.

questions.question: Does the preset selection capture the intended motion without including content or transforms that future targets must keep?
questions.why: The preset omits needed motion or overwrites future target data.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The preset omits needed motion or overwrites future target data.
questions.check: Does the preset's selected-properties list include Source Text, or only the motion properties?
questions.say_example: Source Text is selected, so this preset would include wording that future targets must keep.

questions.question: Was the reusable preset actually written to its retained destination?
questions.why: The reusable preset has not been saved successfully.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The reusable preset has not been saved successfully.
questions.check: Does the save dialog show a permission error at the destination folder?
questions.say_example: The preset save failed at <the Effects folder>: <permission denied>.

questions.question: Does the saved preset recreate the intended motion when applied to another target?
questions.why: The delivered preset is not reusable as promised.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The delivered preset is not reusable as promised.
questions.check: When applied to the test target, does the saved preset reproduce the same motion it had on its original target?
questions.say_example: The saved preset applies, but <the rotation> is missing on the test target.

questions.question: Does the reused text animation start at its new cue while retaining the timing that should stay the same?
questions.why: The replacement text is mistimed or loses the intended motion rhythm.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The replacement text is mistimed or loses the intended motion rhythm.
questions.check: At what time does the reused text layer's animation keyframe start, relative to its assigned cue?
questions.say_example: Started <the caption> at <0:03>

questions.question: Does the reused mask reveal the replacement text without unwanted clipping?
questions.why: The replacement text is incomplete or visibly clipped.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The replacement text is incomplete or visibly clipped.
questions.check: Does the reused mask reveal the replacement text's full width, or does it clip part of the letters?
questions.say_example: The reused mask cuts off <the descenders in 'Sale'> near <0:17>.

questions.question: Does the target use the intended source curve without changing its protected keyframe times or values?
questions.why: Curve reuse changes the wrong data or fails to transfer the intended easing.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: Curve reuse changes the wrong data or fails to transfer the intended easing.
questions.check: After transferring the easing curve, do the target's own keyframe times and values match what they were before the transfer?
questions.say_example: The curve transfer also moved <the peak keyframe> from <0:10> to <0:12>.

children.label: Connect the scene states
children.note: For a continuous change, create 6.1, change 6.2, and resolve 6.3. Existing scenes can go directly to 6.4 for a simple transition. Use 6.12 when the preceding scene also needs changes. Use 6.4 through 6.7 and 6.11 for transition behavior. Use 6.8 through 6.10 where a sequence spans several pages or repeats.

questions.question: Do the continuing objects finish in the positions requested for the destination scene?
questions.why: The movement ends in the wrong composition.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The movement ends in the wrong composition.
questions.check: What position does the object show at its destination keyframe in the target scene?
questions.say_example: Set <the ball> to finish at <the bottom-right corner>

questions.question: Does the object finish at the size requested for the destination scene?
questions.why: The object ends too large or too small for its intended role.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The object ends too large or too small for its intended role.

questions.question: Is the intended item in the featured position, with the surrounding items placed and layered as requested?

questions.check: In the featured layout, is the intended focal item's boundary covered by another element, or does it sit unobstructed in front?

questions.question: Do the focused and background images keep the established sizes and proportions as their roles change?

questions.check: What width and height values do the focused and unfocused images show after the focus change?
questions.say_example: Set <the product photo> to <80%>

questions.question: Do the ending sky and sun position match the requested sunrise scene?

questions.check: By the ending keyframe, does the background gradient and sun position show a state distinct from the starting sky, or the same state?

questions.question: Does the destination contain the shape required for the requested shape change?

questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The scene cannot demonstrate the requested shape change.
questions.check: Does the destination slide contain a shape different from the source, or the same shape as the source?

questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The delivered animation loses required sound or presents it incorrectly.
questions.check: Does the exported file include the required sound, at the same timing it had in the authored project?
questions.say_example: The export is missing <the background music track>. I'll restore it and check the affected passage.

questions.question: Does the exported file import and play correctly in the required downstream editor or player?
questions.why: The asset cannot serve the requested next step.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The asset cannot serve the requested next step.
questions.check: Does the downstream editor or player show an error or rejection message when opening this file?
questions.say_example: <YouTube> rejects this file with <an unsupported codec error>. I'll produce a compatible copy.

questions.question: Does the selected transfer match the authorized destination, account, and audience?
questions.why: The animation could be sent to the wrong place or exposed to an unintended audience.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The animation could be sent to the wrong place or exposed to an unintended audience.
questions.check: Does the selected sharing destination and audience match the audience already authorized for this transfer?
questions.say_example: The selected audience is <Public>, but you authorized <Unlisted>. I'll correct it before transferring.

questions.question: Is the selected transfer's unresolved audience or destination within the scope you want?
questions.why: Proceeding could expose the animation beyond the user's intended scope.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: Proceeding could expose the animation beyond the user's intended scope.
questions.verify_form: This would send <the finished render> from <the linked account> to <the shared drive>, where <the wider team> can see it. Is that the audience you meant?
questions.check: What audience and destination does the pending transfer or share dialog show?
questions.say_example: This transfer would make <the launch teaser> visible to <the public> on <YouTube>. That audience is not authorized yet.

questions.question: Did the authorized destination receive the intended rendered file?
questions.why: The requested delivery has not reached its destination.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The requested delivery has not reached its destination.
questions.check: Does the destination show a failed or error status for this transfer?
questions.say_example: <The client's shared drive> reports that the transfer failed. I'll retry the authorized delivery after resolving <a permissions error>.

questions.question: Can the intended audience access and play the delivered animation with the required sound?
questions.why: The destination may hold the file while the intended audience still cannot use it.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The destination may hold the file while the intended audience still cannot use it.
questions.check: Does the delivery link show an access error when the intended audience attempts to open it?
questions.say_example: The intended audience gets <an access-denied message> at the delivery link. I'll correct access within the authorized scope.

questions.question: Does the saved project reopen with the assets and editable animation needed for revision?
questions.why: The editable handoff cannot support the requested revisions.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The editable handoff cannot support the requested revisions.
questions.check: When the saved project reopens, do all its linked assets resolve, or does any asset show as missing/broken?
questions.say_example: The reopened project cannot find <the background music file>. I'll include it or repair its link.

questions.question: Did the intended composition reach the selected render queue?
questions.why: Rendering may not start or may use the wrong animation.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: Rendering may not start or may use the wrong animation.
questions.check: Does the render queue show the composition that was intended for this export?
questions.say_example: The queue contains <the draft comp>, but this export needs <the final comp>. I'll correct the queue item.

questions.question: Does the rendered animation follow any watermark or branding requirement in the request?
questions.why: The output may be unsuitable for the intended presentation or delivery.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The output may be unsuitable for the intended presentation or delivery.
questions.check: Does the rendered output show a watermark, when the request excludes one?
questions.say_example: The export includes <the trial watermark>, which the request excludes. I'll check the available way to remove it.

questions.question: Does the selected export include exactly the compositions, pages, or timeline range requested?
questions.why: The rendered file would contain the wrong portion of the animation.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The rendered file would contain the wrong portion of the animation.
questions.check: Does the export's selected range include content beyond the requested endpoint?
questions.say_example: The export includes <a bonus outro scene>, but the request ends at <the credits>. I'll correct the selection.

questions.question: Is the displayed export duration consistent with the frame count and frame rate at the display's precision?
questions.why: An inconsistent summary may indicate an unintended export range or timing setting.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: An inconsistent summary may indicate an unintended export range or timing setting.
questions.check: Does the displayed export duration match what the frame count and frame rate imply, within the display's rounding precision?
questions.say_example: The frame count and rate imply <32.4 seconds>, which conflicts with the summary's stated precision. I'll check the export range.

questions.question: Is the displayed export-size estimate within the applicable delivery limit?
questions.why: The current settings may produce a file that needs another export before delivery.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The current settings may produce a file that needs another export before delivery.
questions.check: Does the displayed estimated file size stay within the platform's stated upload limit?
questions.say_example: The estimate is <220MB>, above the <100MB> delivery limit. I'll check settings that still meet the quality requirements.

questions.question: Does the export setting for combined or separate files match the requested delivery?
questions.why: The recipient would receive the wrong arrangement of scene files.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The recipient would receive the wrong arrangement of scene files.
questions.check: Is the export's combined/separate-files setting set to what the requested delivery format calls for?
questions.say_example: The export is set to separate clips, but you asked for one continuous animation. I'll change that setting.

questions.question: Can the selected export settings be used with the current plan?
questions.why: The requested export cannot proceed with those settings under current access.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The requested export cannot proceed with those settings under current access.
questions.check: Does the export dialog flag any selected setting as requiring a Pro subscription the current plan doesn't have?
questions.say_example: <4K export> is blocked under the current plan. I'll check an available option that still meets the request.

questions.question: Is any asset or effect used in this animation blocking the requested export?
questions.why: The animation cannot be exported as configured.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The animation cannot be exported as configured.
questions.check: Does the export dialog flag any specific layer or effect as premium content blocking a free download?
questions.say_example: <The premium stock clip> is blocking this export. I'll check an available replacement that preserves the requested result.
